name: BEND REEFER & TRAILER REPAIR
address: 1315 SE ARMOUR STREET UNIT B, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Building; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Landscaped Area; Access Road; Dumpster Enclosure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Outdoor Storage; Dense Vegetation
fr.recommendations:
• Keep the single access road clear of parked vehicles and stored materials at all times to maintain unobstructed emergency vehicle entry and exit.

• Mark the single access point with reflective address signage visible from the approach road in both directions.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach all sides of the building.

• Identify and mark a designated emergency vehicle turnaround or staging area within the property, as a single access point limits repositioning options.

• Keep outdoor storage consolidated and away from the building exterior and drive aisle to maintain clear movement paths for responders on foot and in vehicles.

• Trim dense vegetation along the access road and drive aisle to maintain sight lines and clearance for emergency vehicles.

• Keep the dumpster enclosure gates closed and confirm the enclosure does not block or narrow the drive aisle or building access points.

• Post a visible site map or directory at the access point identifying the main building entrance, dumpster enclosure location, and any utility shutoffs accessible from the exterior.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Open Paved Area; Vegetation Near Building; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Landscaped Island
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs and low branches on trees located near the building where vegetation is in direct contact or close proximity to the structure.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from the landscaped island to reduce concentrated burnable material in the paved area.
• Keep the edges of paved areas and access routes clear of encroaching shrubs or low-hanging branches that could obstruct vehicle movement.
• Thin shrubs in scattered concentrations near the building to create gaps between individual plants.
